data.heading: Sign in to Adamson
data.text: One sign-in for three levels of access. Adamson approves every account.

levels.title: Public
levels.text: Anyone can browse products, download manuals and data sheets, and read news. No account needed.

levels.title: Approved clients
levels.text: Rental companies, integrators and distributors get pricing, technical resources, reference designs and order history.

levels.title: Admins
levels.text: Adamson sales directors and admins approve accounts and manage what each client can see.

data.requestText: No account yet? Adamson approves each one.
data.notConnected: Sign-in isn’t connected yet in this preview. Please contact your Adamson representative.
